One of my favorite parts of putting Ella’s dorm together was finding little ways to make a very basic space feel cozy and more like her. We didn’t do anything complicated or permanent, just a handful of DIY projects that added warmth, personality, and function. These are five simple DIY ideas that can work in a dorm, apartment, rental, bedroom, or really anywhere you want to add a little more character.

5. Hang Mugs Under Your Cabinets
